snippet.title: Millennium Auction Demo
snippet.description:
This is the demo included on the second disc of Millennium Auction, a 1994 virtual auction game by Eidolon. This video gives an overview of how the game works as well as the characters you interact with and the types of items up for bid. This game is set in a futuristic 2011 as imagined in 1994, so it has a lot of intentionally funny ideas about, say, President Clinton.

Interestingly, this demo seems to use a different, probably earlier interface than the full game, mostly in terms of the fonts and using font colors to highlight bidding information.

Read more about Millennium Auction on The Obscuritory: https://obscuritory.com/other/millennium-auction/
